html:
Here is a new image of Messier 33, a spiral galaxy located in the constellation Triangulum (the Triangle). It is located about 3 million light-years away and contains 30 to 40 billion stars.



Technical details
Telescope: Takahashi SKY90 II with dedicated f 4.5 focal reducer (407mm focal length)
Sensor: Canon 40D unfiltered
Filter: IDAS-LPS (to counter light pollution)
Mount: LX200 10" classic
Guiding: DSI pro and PHD on the LX 10" at f 4.0

40 frames of 300 seconds, 40 darks, 20 flats
Stacking in nebulosity
Processing in photoshop
